description.en: Fluctuating areas of IDF ground operations and control (corridors, buffer zones, Rafah/Philadelphi from May 2024), with a partial pullback during the Jan-March 2025 ceasefire.
description.ar: مناطق متقلبة لعمليات القوات البرية الإسرائيلية وسيطرتها (ممرات، مناطق عازلة، رفح/فيلادلفيا منذ أيار/مايو 2024)، مع انسحاب جزئي أثناء وقف إطلاق النار في كانون الثاني/يناير–آذار/مارس 2025.
description.he: אזורים משתנים של פעולות כוחות היבשה של צה״ל ושליטתם (מסדרונות, אזורי חיץ, רפיח/פילדלפי מאז מאי 2024), עם נסיגה חלקית בהפסקת האש בינואר–מרץ 2025.

sources.quote: Soon after the authorization Israeli forces began moving to take control of the Rafah border crossing and the Philadelphi Corridor.
On 27 October, landlines, cellular and internet services were cut across Gaza, shortly after the Israeli military announced extended ground operations and airstrikes.
Additionally, Israeli infantry and armored vehicles entered various areas within Gaza and clashed with Palestinian armed groups.
On 7 May, a ground operation by the Israeli military began in eastern Rafah, including the areas of Rafah and Kerem Shalom crossings
On 19 January 2025, at 11:15, a ceasefire between Israel and Palestinian armed groups came into effect, through mediation by Egypt, Qatar and the United States.
withdrawal of Israeli forces from population centres except for identified buffer zones
On 9 February, as part of the first 42-day phase of the ceasefire agreement, Israeli forces completed their withdrawal from the Netzarim corridor.
The renewed enforcement of the ceasefire, which initially came into effect at noon on 10 October, was announced on 19 October
the Israeli military, which maintains presence in more than 50 per cent of the Gaza Strip, announced that works began to demarcate the Yellow Line
shortly after the Israeli military announced extended ground operations and airstrikes

notes.en: Start: the Israeli military announced extended ground operations on 27 October 2023 (OCHA Flash Update #21), and infantry and armoured vehicles entered Gaza within the following 24 hours (#22); Britannica says only 'at the end of October'. Not to be drawn as a polygon.
notes.ar: البداية: أعلن الجيش الإسرائيلي توسيع العمليات البرية في 27 تشرين الأول/أكتوبر 2023 (OCHA، التحديث العاجل رقم 21)، ودخلت المشاة والمركبات المدرعة غزة خلال الأربع والعشرين ساعة التالية (رقم 22)؛ وتقول Britannica فقط «في نهاية تشرين الأول/أكتوبر». لا يُرسم كمضلّع.
notes.he: התחלה: הצבא הישראלי הודיע על הרחבת הפעולות הקרקעיות ב-27 באוקטובר 2023 (OCHA, עדכון מיידי מס׳ 21), וחיל רגלים וכלי רכב משוריינים נכנסו לעזה בתוך 24 השעות שלאחר מכן (מס׳ 22); Britannica אומרת רק “בסוף אוקטובר”. אין לשרטט כשטח במפה.

description.en: The eastern, northern and southern parts of Gaza behind the 'Yellow Line': about 53% at the ceasefire, later estimated at roughly 58-70% depending on source and definition (see notes).
description.ar: الأجزاء الشرقية والشمالية والجنوبية من غزة خلف 'الخط الأصفر': نحو 53% عند وقف إطلاق النار، وقُدّرت لاحقًا بنحو 58-70% بحسب المصدر والتعريف (انظر الملاحظات).
description.he: החלקים המזרחיים, הצפוניים והדרומיים של עזה מאחורי “הקו הצהוב”: כ-53% בעת הפסקת האש, ובהמשך הוערכו בכ-58-70% לפי המקור וההגדרה (ראו הערות).

sources.quote: Israel's military would be redeployed to the so-called Yellow Line, as they gradually withdraw under a plan proposed by US President Donald Trump.
The Israeli military remains deployed in over 50 per cent of the Gaza Strip north, west and south of the "Yellow Line,"
The IDF has expanded its operational control to approximately 70% of the Gaza Strip
The area within the Yellow Line now amounts to about 64 percent of the Gaza Strip
According to OCHA, restrictions now cover 65 percent of Gaza.
Israel now controls 60 per cent of Gaza, its military has confirmed, up from the 53 per cent agreed to in last year's ceasefire negotiations.

notes.en: Deliberately no polygon. The 65% OCHA figure was seen only as reported by Al Jazeera; the OCHA document itself was not located.
notes.ar: لا مضلع عن قصد. رقم OCHA البالغ 65% لم يُرَ إلا كما أوردته الجزيرة؛ ولم يُعثر على وثيقة OCHA نفسها.
notes.he: במכוון ללא מצולע. נתון OCHA של 65% נראה רק כפי שדווח על ידי אל-ג'זירה; מסמך OCHA עצמו לא אותר.
